---

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Critical smart contract security vulnerabilities that could lead to immediate loss of funds MUST NOT be submitted via public issues. Email **security@royalstream.io** directly.

**Security Category**
- [ ] Smart Contract Vulnerability (`soroban-contracts/royalty-vault`)
- [ ] Oracle Revenue Attestation Dispute / Statement Hash Discrepancy
- [ ] Wallet Client / Key Handling Flaw (`packages/stellar-sdk`)
- [ ] Backend API Authorization Issue (`apps/backend-api`)

**Severity Level**
- [ ] Critical (Direct fund exploit or state corruption)
- [ ] High (Accounting discrepancy or authorization flaw)
- [ ] Medium (Oracle dispute timelock bypass)
- [ ] Low (Information disclosure)

**Summary of Vulnerability / Dispute**
Detailed description of the issue.

**Proof of Concept / Technical Steps**
Steps to reproduce the vulnerability or details of the disputed revenue statement hash.
